_doc: The slot of OpenBuilds V-Slot linear rail: a T-slot whose mouth is a V, so that a wheel with a V rim runs in it. Opening (6.25), the lip (1.80), the width under the lips (11), the height under the lips (4.30), the V's width at the face (9.16) and its angle (90 degrees) are printed on OpenBuilds' drawings; the floor and the flanks are scaled off them, and say so. OpenBuilds shares its design work under CC BY-SA 4.0: dimensions are taken, the shape is not, and the kit draws the slot from these figures. The drawn slot leaves out the small V mark in the middle of the floor. Clones are sold under the same name with other figures: measure yours.
name: slot-6-openbuilds

opening.rule: Between the lips below the V, 6.25 on the drawing
opening.source: OpenBuilds, dimension drawing in the gallery of its product page "V-Slot 20x40 Linear Rail" (image 13605), https://us.openbuilds.com/v-slot-20x40-linear-rail/ as the Internet Archive saved it on 2025-12-07, https://web.archive.org/web/2025/https://us.openbuilds.com/v-slot-20x40-linear-rail/

lip_thickness.rule: From the face to the underside of the lip: 1.80 on the drawing (the gallery image's scale gives 1.79)
lip_thickness.source: OpenBuilds, dimension drawing "V-Slot 20X40 Linear Rail" (PDF), as mirrored in the OpenBuilds drawings folder of github.com/eric-wieser/2.12-robot, https://github.com/eric-wieser/2.12-robot/tree/master/hardware/Third-party/Openbuilds/PDF%20Drawings

cavity_width.rule: Width under the lips, 11 on the drawing
cavity_width.source: OpenBuilds, dimension drawing in the gallery of its product page "V-Slot 20x40 Linear Rail" (image 13605), https://us.openbuilds.com/v-slot-20x40-linear-rail/ as the Internet Archive saved it on 2025-12-07, https://web.archive.org/web/2025/https://us.openbuilds.com/v-slot-20x40-linear-rail/

cavity_depth.rule: From the face to the floor: the drawing prints 1.80 from the face to the underside of the lip and 4.30 from there to the floor, so 6.10
cavity_depth.source: OpenBuilds, dimension drawing "V-Slot 20X40 Linear Rail" (PDF), as mirrored in the OpenBuilds drawings folder of github.com/eric-wieser/2.12-robot, https://github.com/eric-wieser/2.12-robot/tree/master/hardware/Third-party/Openbuilds/PDF%20Drawings

floor_width.rule: Width of the flat floor: the walls run straight to about 3.4 mm below the face, then close in at 45 degrees. Not dimensioned: measure yours
floor_width.source: scaled off OpenBuilds, dimension drawing in the gallery of its product page "V-Slot 20x40 Linear Rail" (image 13605), https://us.openbuilds.com/v-slot-20x40-linear-rail/ as the Internet Archive saved it on 2025-12-07, https://web.archive.org/web/2025/https://us.openbuilds.com/v-slot-20x40-linear-rail/ (1500 pixels for 63.8 mm; the drawing prints no figure for it)

flank_angle.rule: The flanks close in at 45 degrees, as drawn. Not dimensioned
flank_angle.source: scaled off OpenBuilds, dimension drawing in the gallery of its product page "V-Slot 20x40 Linear Rail" (image 13605), https://us.openbuilds.com/v-slot-20x40-linear-rail/ as the Internet Archive saved it on 2025-12-07, https://web.archive.org/web/2025/https://us.openbuilds.com/v-slot-20x40-linear-rail/ (1500 pixels for 63.8 mm; the drawing prints no figure for it)

track_width.rule: Width of the V at the face, where a wheel's rim enters: 9.16 on the drawing, the V running 1.455 mm down to the 6.25 opening at 45 degrees a side. A clone's track may differ: measure yours before a wheel is fitted to it
track_width.source: OpenBuilds, dimension drawing "V-Slot 20X40 Linear Rail" (PDF), as mirrored in the OpenBuilds drawings folder of github.com/eric-wieser/2.12-robot, https://github.com/eric-wieser/2.12-robot/tree/master/hardware/Third-party/Openbuilds/PDF%20Drawings

track_angle.rule: The V's two sides are at right angles to each other (each at 45 degrees to the face): 90 degrees on the drawing
track_angle.source: OpenBuilds, dimension drawing "V-Slot 20X40 Linear Rail" (PDF), as mirrored in the OpenBuilds drawings folder of github.com/eric-wieser/2.12-robot, https://github.com/eric-wieser/2.12-robot/tree/master/hardware/Third-party/Openbuilds/PDF%20Drawings

nut_family.rule: It takes the tee nuts sold for V-Slot (M5): the cavity is narrower and shallower than a 20 mm T-slot's (11 against 12), so not every 20 series nut goes in
nut_family.source: OpenBuilds, dimension drawing in the gallery of its product page "V-Slot 20x40 Linear Rail" (image 13605), https://us.openbuilds.com/v-slot-20x40-linear-rail/ as the Internet Archive saved it on 2025-12-07, https://web.archive.org/web/2025/https://us.openbuilds.com/v-slot-20x40-linear-rail/
